profile.description: ISA-neutral serving control: same server semantics and per-item INT8 decoder shape, with no AMX Design-D/ragged decoder request.

quality_gate.command: strict profile preflight + current serving-generation structural/audio gate
quality_gate.audio_gate: same model, voice, language, seed/settings and bank; valid non-empty PCM/WAV plus applicable same-generation parity checks

parity.notes: This lane answers same serving architecture versus hardware/ISA. It intentionally gives up AMX ragged decoder and fused residual so the product lanes are not confused with the common control.

hardware.cpu_family: x86 AVX2 through AMX/VNNI or Arm dotprod/i8mm campaign host
hardware.notes: Topology and ISA backend remain host facts; only the serving/decoder contract is held constant.

build.target: host-specific SIMD build; no AMX-only decoder request

requirements.isa: one of the declared x86/Arm CPU classes

precision.gemm_backend: native per ISA; no AMX/KAI-only decoder path

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: keep the external BLAS pool from spinning against the engine pool

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: must be absent so engine-owned BLAS sizing is effective

OMP_NUM_THREADS.why: must be absent; the engine profile owns the CPU budget

QWEN_CP_PREFILL2.why: remove the VNNI/Arm-specific CP prefill2 policy from the common control

QWEN_DECODER_BATCH.why: the only current decoder shape common to all three backend families is per-item decoding

QWEN_KAI_LHS.why: no ISA-specific KAI LHS policy in the common control

QWEN_KAI_QKV_FUSED.why: no ISA-specific KAI QKV policy in the common control

QWEN_AVX2_INT8_GEMV.why: keep unqualified AVX2 integer GEMV candidates off in the common control

QWEN_AVX2_Q4_GEMV.why: keep unqualified AVX2 Q4 GEMV candidates off in the common control

QWEN_AVX512_INT8_GEMV.why: keep unqualified no-VNNI AVX-512 integer GEMV candidates off in the common control

QWEN_AVX512_Q4_GEMV.why: keep unqualified no-VNNI AVX-512 Q4 GEMV candidates off in the common control

QWEN_NO_AMX.why: disable AMX-only generic and decoder paths

QWEN_NO_KLEIDI.why: disable KAI-only generic path in the common control

QWEN_NO_VNNI.why: leave the ordinary x86 VNNI fallback available; AMX is disabled explicitly

QWEN_NO_VNNI_TILE.why: retain the native x86 VNNI tile where the common build has it

QWEN_KLEIDI_MIN_B.why: pin the KAI common-control gate even though KAI is disabled

QWEN_KAI_NCHUNK.why: not a common-control setting; record only in the Arm product lane

QWEN_NO_SDOT.why: Arm per-item INT8 decoder remains the native common decoder leaf

QWEN_POOL_SPIN.why: common-control reference value; host-specific tuning is not claimed

QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT.why: force the common FP32 prefill policy

QWEN_SD_AMX.why: legacy decoder switch; Design-D is disabled explicitly

QWEN_SD_INT8.why: same logical per-item INT8 decoder algorithm

QWEN_SD_INT8_BLK.why: pin the common decoder quantization block

QWEN_SD_RAG_MIN_PANELS.why: retained as explicit but inactive for decoder batch=0

QWEN_SD_WINDOWED.why: explicitly disable the legacy windowed fallback so the exact streaming decoder semantics are resolved

QWEN_SERVER_NO_DECODER_BATCH.why: absence is explicit; decoder batch is disabled by QWEN_DECODER_BATCH=0

QWEN_TTS_STREAM_LAYOUT.why: same known-text serving layout across ISA lanes; ICL/clone and live incremental text remain outside this control

QWEN_NO_BF16_MATMUL.why: force the common FP32 prefill policy

qualification.workload: Operational common-control contract; no new hardware result is claimed by this file.
qualification.notes: The common control removes current accelerated decoder asymmetries; it is not the best product configuration for any ISA.
